# MIDAS Equation
Original MIDAS equation
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$

## MIDAS Matrix Form



MIDAS r without trend
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \phi\, y_{t-2} + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$

MIDAS r with trend
$$
y_t = \beta_0 + \phi\, y_{t-2} + \delta\, t + \sum_{k=0}^{K} \beta(k;\theta)\, x_{t-k/m} + \varepsilon_t
$$
